content.text: Hello everyone and welcome to EnglishPod. My name is Marco.
content.trans: 你好，大家和欢迎来到英语播客。我的名字是马克。

content.text: My name is Catherine and if you've been listening to our recent lessons you know that we've
content.trans: 我的名字是凯西，如果你已经听我们的最近课程了，那么你一定知道我们正在讨论的话题。

content.text: been talking a lot about food.
content.trans: 英语：我一直都在谈论食物。

content.text: That's right and today we have another lesson all about food from a different country.
content.trans: 英语：那对的，今天我们又学习了关于从不同国家来的食物。

content.text: Last time we took a look at Mexican food, Chinese food now we are talking about Indian food.
content.trans: 上一次我们看了墨西哥的食物，现在我们正在谈论印度的食物。

content.text: Okay Indian food is very famous for being spicy but not all of it is spicy.
content.trans: 英语：它很受欢迎，因为很多印度菜都是辣的，但不是所有的都辣。

content.text: Let's take a listen to today's dialogue and find out just what kinds of food you will
content.trans: 让我们听听今天的对话，看看你将吃到哪些食物。

content.text: find at an Indian restaurant.
content.trans: 找到一家印度餐厅。

content.text: So where is this mystery restaurant that we're going to?
content.trans: 英语：所以这个我们要去的神秘餐厅在哪里呢？

content.text: It's an Indian restaurant. I know you have never had Indian food so I thought you might want
content.trans: 英语：它是一家印度餐厅。我知道你从未吃过印度食物，所以我猜测你可能想要。

content.text: to try it.
content.trans: 尝试它。

content.text: That sounds great. I am craving some type of beef dish.
content.trans: 这句话的意思是：“听起来不错。我正渴望一些牛肉菜肴。”

content.text: Well Indian cuisine actually doesn't serve beef. You see cows are a sacred animal, a very
content.trans: 印度菜实际上并不提供牛肉。你看牛是神圣的动物，是非常重要的。

content.text: important element in the Hindu religion so beef is not eaten.
content.trans: 重要元素在印度教中，所以牛肉不能食用。

content.text: I see. So what are we having?
content.trans: 我看到。所以我们正在做什么？

content.text: There are many amazing dishes to choose from. We can have some chicken tikka masala which is an
content.trans: 有很多美味的菜肴可以选择。我们可以尝试一下鸡肉泰式咖喱，这是一道非常受欢迎的泰国菜。

content.text: amazing curry. It's a bit spicy but I think you can handle it.
content.trans: 英语：超棒的咖喱。它有点辣，但我认为你可以处理的。

content.text: Sounds good. I've always heard that Indian spices give a rich flavor to food.
content.trans: 英语：听起来不错。我一直听说印度香料为食物增添了一份丰富风味。

content.text: Yeah. Also we can have some non bread which has baked in a tandoori oven.
content.trans: 是的。我们也可以有一些没有烤熟在印度厨房里的东西。

content.text: Since you don't use any utensils to eat you can use this bread to scoop up the
content.trans: 自从你不用餐具来吃，你可以用这个面包来舀取。

content.text: curry you're right.
content.trans: 你真是对的。

content.text: What about veggies?
content.trans: 关于蔬菜？

content.text: Oh they have a good variety of vegetable based dishes like palak paneer, vegetable
content.trans: 英语：他们有各种蔬菜类的主菜，比如炒青椒、炒菠菜等。

content.text: samosas or dal.
content.trans: 萨莫亚斯或干巴。

content.text: It all sounds so exquisite. I can't wait.
content.trans: 英语：它听起来真是太精致了。我迫不及待了。

content.text: Alright we're back. So now let's take a look at a couple of words and phrases here on
content.trans: 好的，我明白了。现在让我们一起来看看一些词汇和短语吧。

content.text: language takeaway.
content.trans: 语言小贴士。

content.text: Language takeaway.
content.trans: 语言总结。

content.text: So in this first language takeaway today we have words that are about the kinds of food
content.trans: 英语：所以今天在第一语言取向中，我们有关于食物的词汇。

content.text: we're eating today.
content.trans: 我们今天吃东西。

content.text: So the first one the character said I am craving some type of beef so to crave something.
content.trans: 所以第一个他所说的，我想要一些牛肉。

content.text: Okay so that is a verb to crave and that means that you have a desire. You really want
content.trans: 好的，那么这就是一个动词“渴望”，意味着你有欲望。你真的很想要

content.text: to eat something to have a particular thing.
content.trans: 吃点什么来得到某个特定的东西。

content.text: That's right but it's particular so it's something specific. For example pregnant women are
content.trans: 英语：那对，但具体一点，所以例如孕妇就是特别的。

content.text: famous for craving strange foods like pickles.
content.trans: 英语：著名的因为喜欢奇怪的食物，比如腌菜。

content.text: Yeah exactly. So if you say I'm craving some ice cream you specifically want ice cream or
content.trans: 是的，你说得对。如果你说我要一些冰淇淋，你想要的是冰淇淋还是其他的东西？

content.text: maybe vanilla ice cream.
content.trans: 或许就是 vanilla 冰淇淋。

content.text: Exactly.
content.trans: 正确翻译为中文是：“正好。”

content.text: And this person wants beef but unfortunately there's no beef at Indian restaurants because
content.trans: 这个人想要牛肉，但不幸的是，在印度餐厅里没有牛肉。

content.text: cows are what?
content.trans: 牛奶是什么？

content.text: Cows are a sacred animal so they are sacred in India.
content.trans: 印度的牛是神圣的，所以它们在印度被视为神圣。

content.text: Sacred means special or somehow important in a religious way.
content.trans: 释义：神圣意味着在宗教中具有特殊或重要性。

content.text: For example you could say this is a very sacred place so please don't use cameras or phones
content.trans: 英语：例如，你可以这样描述这是个非常神圣的地方，请不要使用相机或手机。

content.text: and take your shoes off.
content.trans: 和脱鞋一样。

content.text: That's right so the word sacred refers to something that is religious and very important for that religion.
content.trans: 没错，那么“神圣”一词指的是宗教中非常重要的、值得尊敬的东西。

content.text: Specifically in this occasion we're talking about the Hindu religion.
content.trans: 在这个场合，我们主要讨论印度教。

content.text: Okay so the Hindu religion or Hinduism is a religion that's widely practiced in the world and
content.trans: 好的，所以佛教或印度教是世界上广泛实践的宗教之一。

content.text: maybe most commonly found in India.
content.trans: 英语：它很可能是印度最常见的。

content.text: So you'll see a lot of Hindu temples in India and people don't eat beef like we said because
content.trans: 所以你会看到印度很多佛塔，人们不吃牛肉，因为我们说的。

content.text: cows are sacred in the Hindu religion.
content.trans: 牛在中国宗教中被视为神圣的。

content.text: That's right.
content.trans: 没错。

content.text: Okay so now in India or for Indian food it's common to not use any type of utensil to eat.
content.trans: 英语：现在在印度或吃印度食物时，通常不需要使用任何餐具来吃饭。

content.text: Okay so you might be wondering what is a utensil?
content.trans: 好的，那么请告诉我一个关于物品的疑问。

content.text: I know forks, I know spoons.
content.trans: 我认识叉子，我也认识勺子。

content.text: Well utensil is the word that describes all forks spoons and knives, things that you eat with.
content.trans: 餐具是指所有叉、勺和刀等用来吃的东西。

content.text: Okay so utensils are tools for eating and it's a very general category.
content.trans: 好的，所以餐具是用来吃饭的工具，这是一个非常广泛的类别。

content.text: Right exactly.
content.trans: 正确答案：完全正确。

content.text: So utensils are spoons, forks, knives, everything.
content.trans: 所以餐具是叉子、勺子、刀子，等等。

content.text: Topsticks are utensils even.
content.trans: 顶级筷子是餐具。

content.text: Okay very good.
content.trans: 好的，很好。

content.text: And now since we don't use any utensils you usually eat with your hand and you scoop up the food, the rice or the curry.
content.trans: 现在，因为我们在饭前自己动手吃饭，所以米饭或咖喱。

content.text: Okay to scoop up this is a verb and usually you use your hands to scoop something.
content.trans: 好的，可以舀取这个是动词，通常你用双手来舀取东西。

content.text: So in this case I can use a piece of bread to scoop up or to pick up some food.
content.trans: 所以，在这种情况下，我可以用一块面包来舀或捡起一些食物。

content.text: That's right so the verb to scoop up it usually means that you somehow make a little bowl or
content.trans: 没错，所以这个动词“to scoop up”通常意味着你通过某种方式使一个小碗或容器变得有些小。

content.text: a little figure with your hand so that the liquid or the food will fit inside kind of like a little scoop.
content.trans: 一个手拿着小物体，这样液体或食物可以像一个小勺子一样放入。

content.text: Or a little cup that's right.
content.trans: 英语：或者一个杯子，正好。

content.text: So to scoop up, scoop something up.
content.trans: 所以，要收集，收集什么。

content.text: Alright so now let's go back, let's review this dialogue and when we come back we're going to take a look at the specific Indian dishes found in this dialogue.
content.trans: 好的，现在让我们回到对话开始的地方，让我们回顾一下这个对话中提到的印度菜肴。

content.text: So where's this mystery restaurant that we're going to?
content.trans: 英语：所以这个神秘的餐厅我们要去不了。

content.text: It's an Indian restaurant.
content.trans: 它是一家印度餐厅。

content.text: I know you have never had Indian food so I thought you might want to try it.
content.trans: 我了解你从未吃过印度食物，所以我猜测你可能想尝试一下。

content.text: That sounds great.
content.trans: 听起来不错。

content.text: I am craving some type of beef dish.
content.trans: 我正在寻找一些牛肉菜肴。

content.text: Well Indian cuisine actually doesn't serve beef.
content.trans: 英语：印度菜实际上并不提供牛肉。

content.text: You see cows are a sacred animal, a very important element in the Hindu religion so beef is not eaten.
content.trans: 英语：你看到牛是神圣的动物，非常重要的元素之一，在印度教中不吃牛肉。

content.text: I see.
content.trans: 我看见。

content.text: So what are we having?
content.trans: 英语：所以我们正在做什么？

content.text: Chicken.
content.trans: 鸡蛋。

content.text: There are many amazing dishes to choose from.
content.trans: 有很多美味的食物可以选择。

content.text: We can have some chicken tikka masala which is an amazing curry.
content.trans: 我们能尝尝一些鸡肉泰式咖喱，这是一道非常美味的咖喱。

content.text: It's a bit spicy but I think you can handle it.
content.trans: 英语：它有点辣，但我认为你能处理好。

content.text: Sounds good.
content.trans: 好的。

content.text: I've always heard that Indian spices give a rich flavor to food.
content.trans: 我一直在听老话说，印度香料能为食物增添丰富的风味。

content.text: Yeah.
content.trans: 是。

content.text: Also we can have some non bread which has baked in a tandoori oven.
content.trans: 英语：还我们可以有一些带有烤制过的豆子的面点。

content.text: Since you don't use any utensils to eat you can use this bread to scoop up the curry, right?
content.trans: 因为您不用用任何工具来吃，您可以使用这个面包来舀起咖喱，对吗？

content.text: What about veggies?
content.trans: 关于蔬菜？

content.text: Oh they have a good variety of vegetable-based dishes like palak paneer, vegetable samosas or dal.
content.trans: 英语：他们有各种蔬菜基底的菜肴，比如炒青椒、炒菠菜或炒豆腐。

content.text: It all sounds so exquisite.
content.trans: 英语：它听起来真是太精致了。

content.text: I can't wait.
content.trans: 我迫不及待了。

content.text: Alright we're back so now let's take a look at those dishes on Language Takeaway Part 2.
content.trans: 好的，我们已经回来。现在让我们来看看Part 2中的那些菜肴。

content.text: Now Marco these lessons are making me so hungry and we've been doing them for a couple weeks now.
content.trans: 现在莫卡斯这些课程让我胃口大开，我们已经持续学习了两周多了。

content.text: And this one is no exception.
content.trans: 而且这个也是例外。

content.text: We talked a little bit today about chicken dishes and vegetable dishes but a very general kind of dish in Indian food is a curry.
content.trans: 我们今天聊了鸡丁和豆皮，但印度菜里的一个普遍类型是咖喱。

content.text: That's right, a curry.
content.trans: 没错，这是咖喱。

content.text: Now this is a noun and it's a dish that has a variety of spices in it.
content.trans: 现在这个是个名词，它里面有一个菜，里面有各种调料。

content.text: That's right so there are many different flavors, not just one flavor.
content.trans: 没错，所以有很多不同的口味，不仅仅是单一的口味。

content.text: You can have chicken curries and vegetable curries and mutton or lamb curries.
content.trans: 你可以说炒鸡的鸡肉咖喱和羊肉咖喱，或者说炖肉或煮肉的咖喱。

content.text: But the thing that you need to remember in Indian food is that there's usually different colors of curry.
content.trans: 但是，在印度食物中，通常会有不同的咖喱颜色。

content.text: Red, yellow or green curries.
content.trans: 红、黄或绿炒菜。

content.text: That's right exactly.
content.trans: 正确翻译：那正好。

content.text: The dishes are usually called curries and an example of a curry.
content.trans: 英文：菜肴通常被称为咖喱和一道菜的例证。

content.text: We have a chicken tikka masala curry.
content.trans: 我们有一道鸡肉泰式咖喱菜。

content.text: Okay so we know that there's chicken in it and tikka means that it's grilled chicken.
content.trans: 好的，我们已经知道有鸡和泰式咖喱。

content.text: And masala is the name of the spice or the curry, the spice that's in that curry.
content.trans: 英语：和咖喱是辣酱或咖喱粉，咖喱粉在那道菜里。

content.text: Exactly, exactly.
content.trans: 正确，正确。

content.text: So a curry is kind of like a thick sauce with pieces of chicken in it.
content.trans: 所以，一个咖喱是像鸡肉块和一些鸡丁的汤一样稠。

content.text: In this case for the chicken tikka masala, it's a little bit spicy and it's a color red.
content.trans: 在这个案例中，对于鸡肉泰式咖喱酱，它有点辣，颜色是红色的。

content.text: All right so we've got the chicken tikka masala or masala.
content.trans: 英语：所有准备好了，所以我们有咖喱鸡或咖喱粉。

content.text: And usually you eat this with rice or bread.
content.trans: 通常，你吃这个食物通常是用米饭或面包。

content.text: But in India there's a special, there are many different kinds of bread.
content.trans: 但是，在印度，有一种特别的，有很多不同的面包。

content.text: But the special bread we heard today was called non bread.
content.trans: 但是今天我们听到的特别面包叫做非面包。

content.text: Right, non bread.
content.trans: 正确，不面包。

content.text: And it's just basically a type of bread.
content.trans: 而且基本上是一种面包。

content.text: Now it's not like the bread that you usually have at home.
content.trans: 现在，它不像你通常在家吃的面包那么香。

content.text: It's a flat bread.
content.trans: 它是面饼。

content.text: So it kind of looks like a pancake almost.
content.trans: 所以它有点像一个煎饼。

content.text: It does. It's not fluffy. It's flat.
content.trans: 是的，它不是蓬松的。它是平的。

content.text: And the way they cook it is they use this special oven and they cook it inside the oven.
content.trans: 他们用这个特别的炉子烹饪，然后把食物放在炉子里。

content.text: Now the question is what is that oven called?
content.trans: 现在这个问题是“那个烤箱叫什么名字？”

content.text: Marco.
content.trans: 马克。

content.text: That's right. The oven that we heard is a tandoori oven.
content.trans: 没错，我们听到的那台烤箱就是泰式烤箱。

content.text: Okay so tandoori is just the name of this oven.
content.trans: 好的，所以这个烤箱叫这台炉子。

content.text: It's also a style of cooking in India.
content.trans: 它也是印度的一种烹饪风格。

content.text: And it's actually one of my favorite kinds of Indian food because you have these many different kinds of grilled meats.
content.trans: 而且，这其实是我最喜欢的印度食物之一，因为你可以享受到这么多不同的烤肉。

content.text: You can have tandoori chicken, tandoori, mutton, things like that.
content.trans: 你可以说烤鸡、烤肉、羊肉，等等。

content.text: Exactly. So a tandoori oven is a type of oven usually made from clay.
content.trans: 是的。所以，一个塔司炉是一种通常由粘土制成的烤箱。

content.text: That's why it's called tandoori.
content.trans: 因此，它被称为泰式。

content.text: Now towards the end we also have some vegetarian options because as we heard in India they don't eat beef.
content.trans: 现在我们还有一些素食选项，因为正如我们在印度听到的那样，他们不吃牛肉。

content.text: And many people are also vegetarians.
content.trans: 和很多人也是素食主义者。

content.text: They don't eat any type of meat at all.
content.trans: 他们不吃任何肉类。

content.text: So the first vegetable based dish that we heard is a palak paneer.
content.trans: 所以第一道菜是咖喱粉条。

content.text: That's interesting actually because paneer is curd or like a cheese type of cheese type of thing.
content.trans: 这个确实很有趣，因为那是一种像奶酪或类似奶酪的东西。

content.text: So it's usually white and comes in rectangles.
content.trans: 所以通常它会是白色的，并且通常是长方形的。

content.text: And paneer you can have many different flavors of it.
content.trans: 你可以尝试不同的口味来享用奶酪。

content.text: But paneer generally is kind of a cheese, like cottage cheese.
content.trans: 但是 Paneer 通常是一种奶酪，类似于 cottage cheese。

content.text: That's right. And palak is actually spinach.
content.trans: 是的，正确。而且帕拉克实际上是一种菠菜。

content.text: So it's a dish that it kind of looks like a thick sauce, green sauce, which is made out of spinach.
content.trans: 所以它有点像一道浓稠的酱汁，里面是菠菜。

content.text: And within it it has little pieces of this type of cheese.
content.trans: 并且在其中它有这种类型的奶酪碎片。

content.text: I love this dish.
content.trans: 我爱这个菜。

content.text: It's very very delicious.
content.trans: 它是极极美味的。

content.text: And we also have vegetable samosas.
content.trans: 和我们还有蔬菜沙拉呢。

content.text: Now a samosa, what's that?
content.trans: 现在一个萨摩亚，什么？

content.text: This is a great dish.
content.trans: 这个是美味的菜肴。

content.text: This is often used as an appetizer or as a snack.
content.trans: 这个经常被用作开胃菜或零食。

content.text: You see these on carts or on the street in India.
content.trans: 英语：你看到这些在卡车或路边。

content.text: Now samosas are like pyramids or triangles.
content.trans: 现在这些点心像金字塔或三角形一样。

content.text: And inside they have vegetables.
content.trans: 而且里面还有蔬菜。

content.text: So you can have potatoes and peas or lentils.
content.trans: 所以你可以有土豆和豌豆，或者绿豆。

content.text: No, not lentils.
content.trans: 是的，不是豌豆。

content.text: You can have potatoes and peas.
content.trans: 你可以说有土豆和豌豆。

content.text: And they're a little bit crunchy on the outside and soft on the inside.
content.trans: 他们外皮稍微有点脆，内里柔软。

content.text: And they're very tasty.
content.trans: 他们很好吃。

content.text: Yes, the equivalent would be to...
content.trans: 是的，这个等效的表达方式是...。

content.text: It's something like an egg roll, more or less...
content.trans: 英语：它像一个鸡蛋卷，稍微...

content.text: Like a dumpling.
content.trans: 像一个饺子。

content.text: Like a dumpling because it is deep fried.
content.trans: 英语：像一个大饺子，因为是深煎的。

content.text: That's right.
content.trans: 那正是。

content.text: And we also have a doll.
content.trans: 和我们还有个娃娃。

content.text: So this is actually a type of lentil, as you mentioned.
content.trans: 所以，这实际上是一种豆类，您提到的。

content.text: That's right.
content.trans: 没错。

content.text: So doll is a lentil dish and it can be flavored in different ways.
content.trans: 所以豆腐是个炖菜，可以调成各种口味。

content.text: But basically lentils are these very very very small round things.
content.trans: 但是基本上这些是非常非常小的圆球。

content.text: They're very good for your health.
content.trans: 他们对你的健康非常有帮助。

content.text: And doll is kind of a soupy lentil dish.
content.trans: 而且这个娃娃有点像炖菜。

content.text: That's right.
content.trans: 没错。

content.text: So lentil is the category of this type of...
content.trans: 所以豌豆是这种类型的类别...

content.text: I don't know if it's not a grain.
content.trans: 我并不知道是不是没有颗粒。

content.text: It's a legume.
content.trans: 是豆类。

content.text: It's a legume exactly.
content.trans: 它是一种豆类。

content.text: So it may sound a little bit weird, but we'll put some pictures of different types of lentils
content.trans: 所以，这可能听起来有点奇怪，但我们将展示不同类型的鹰嘴豆的照片。

content.text: because it's like saying potatoes.
content.trans: 因为它像在说土豆一样。

content.text: There are many different types of potatoes.
content.trans: 有很多不同的种类的土豆。

content.text: Sweet potato and all this.
content.trans: 甜薯和这一切。

content.text: And the same thing goes with lentils.
content.trans: 同样，豌豆也跟着发芽。

content.text: So we'll put some pictures so you can see what it looks like.
content.trans: 所以我们将放置一些照片，以便您能看到它是什么样子。

content.text: But now why don't we go back?
content.trans: 但是现在我们为什么不回去呢？

content.text: Let's listen to the dialogue again.
content.trans: 让我们再次听对话。

content.text: Let's review everything and we'll be right back.
content.trans: 让我们回顾一下所有的事情，然后我们马上回来。

content.text: So where's this mystery restaurant that we're going to?
content.trans: 英语：所以这个神秘的餐厅我们要去不了。

content.text: It's an Indian restaurant.
content.trans: 它是一家印度餐厅。

content.text: I know you have never had Indian food.
content.trans: 我了解你从未吃过印度食物。

content.text: So I thought you might want to try it.
content.trans: 所以我想你可能想试试这个。

content.text: That sounds great.
content.trans: 听起来不错。

content.text: I am craving some type of beef dish.
content.trans: 我正在寻找一些牛肉菜肴。

content.text: Well, Indian cuisine actually doesn't serve beef.
content.trans: 英语：嗯，印度菜其实不放牛肉。

content.text: You see cows are a sacred animal.
content.trans: 你看到牛是神圣的动物。

content.text: A very important element in the Hindu religion.
content.trans: 一个非常重要的元素在印度教中。

content.text: So beef is not eaten.
content.trans: 所以牛肉不是吃的食物。

content.text: I see.
content.trans: 我看到。

content.text: So what are we having?
content.trans: 英语：所以我们正在做什么？

content.text: Chicken.
content.trans: 鸡蛋。

content.text: There are many amazing dishes to choose from.
content.trans: 有很多美味的食物可以尝试。

content.text: We can have some chicken tikka masala, which is an amazing curry.
content.trans: 我们能尝尝一些鸡肉泰式咖喱，这是一道非常美味的咖喱。

content.text: It's a bit spicy, but I think you can handle it.
content.trans: 英语：它有点辣，但我认为你能处理好。

content.text: Sounds good.
content.trans: 好的。

content.text: I've always heard that Indian spices give a rich flavor to food.
content.trans: 英语：我一直听说印度香料能为食物增添丰富的风味。

content.text: Yeah.
content.trans: 是。

content.text: Also, we can have some non-bread, which has baked in a tandoori oven.
content.trans: 另外，我们还可以有一些非烘焙食品，它们已经烤在了烤炉里。

content.text: Since you don't use any utensils to eat, you can use this bread to scoop up the curry or rice.
content.trans: 因为您不使用任何餐具来吃饭，您可以用这个面包来舀起咖喱或米饭。

content.text: What about veggies?
content.trans: 关于蔬菜？

content.text: Oh, they have a good variety of vegetable-based dishes like palak paneer, vegetable samosas, or dal.
content.trans: 英语：哦，他们有各种蔬菜基底的菜肴，比如咖喱炒饭、蔬菜沙拉或豆沙包。

content.text: It all sounds so exquisite.
content.trans: 英语：它听起来真是太精致了。

content.text: I can't wait.
content.trans: 我迫不及待了。

content.text: All right, we're back.
content.trans: 英语：一切好，我们回来了。

content.text: So Indian food has a reputation of being spicy, but it's very, very delicious.
content.trans: 英语：所以印度食物有被描述为辛辣，但实际上非常美味。

content.text: That's right.
content.trans: 没错。

content.text: And you know, what people always tell me, at least my Indian friends always tell me,
content.trans: 而且你知道，至少我的印度朋友总是告诉我。

content.text: is that Indian food, saying Indian food is like saying Chinese food.
content.trans: 是这样的，印度食物和说印度食物就像说中国食物。

content.text: We have some general idea, but every different part of India has its own special foods.
content.trans: 我们有一些基本的了解，但每个印度的不同部分都有自己独特的美食。

content.text: That's right.
content.trans: 没错。

content.text: And so what we get in America at Indian restaurants might not be the same as what we get at Indian restaurants in India.
content.trans: 美国的印度餐厅可能与在印度的印度餐厅不同。

content.text: So I just want to say that.
content.trans: 英语：所以我只是想说。

content.text: But generally, you can find these dishes at any Indian restaurants in America.
content.trans: 但是通常，你可以在这里找到各种印度餐厅的餐点。

content.text: That's right.
content.trans: 正确。

content.text: Actually, if next time you're in an Indian restaurant, or if you ever go,
content.trans: 实际上，如果下次你去印度餐厅或者你将来有一天会去，

content.text: ask them from what region or what area of India the food is from,
content.trans: 请告诉我他们从哪里或印度哪个地区购买的食物。

content.text: because it may be northern Indian cuisine, and obviously that is going to be a little bit different than maybe the southern.
content.trans: 因为可能是北方印度菜，而且显然那会比南方稍微复杂一些。

content.text: I think the southern is supposed to be spicy.
content.trans: 我感觉南方应该辣。

content.text: Exactly.
content.trans: 正确翻译为中文是：“正好。”

content.text: And it's just like in every country, even in our own home countries,
content.trans: 而且就像在每一个国家一样，甚至在我们的本国之中。

content.text: maybe the food from the coast or from the north will be different from the south or the inland.
content.trans: 英语：也许从海岸或北方来的食物会比南方或内陆的食物要不同。

content.text: And I just want to make one more comment.
content.trans: 而且我只是想再提一个建议。

content.text: One of my favorite things to do that many Indian restaurants offer in America is the lunch buffet.
content.trans: 我的最爱在美国内地的许多印度餐厅，午餐自助餐是我最喜欢的一道菜。

content.text: So a buffet is basically a self-serve of food.
content.trans: 所以自助餐基本上就是自己点菜了。

content.text: So the restaurant will put out many different dishes, and you can take as much as you want to each, but you pay one price.
content.trans: 所以餐厅会提供许多不同的菜肴，你可以根据自己的口味随意选择，但每道菜都要付一个价格。

content.text: So it's $11.99 or something.
content.trans: 英语：所以它$11.99或更多。

content.text: That's very, very good.
content.trans: 那真是太好了。

content.text: And yeah, so I often do this when I'm home in the States, and I just, you know,
content.trans: 而且，我经常在家里美国做这件事，你知道……

content.text: I get to pick my favorite dishes, and I eat as much as I want.
content.trans: 我可以选择我的最爱菜肴，而且吃得比别人多。

content.text: And actually, I think one other thing that's worth mentioning,
content.trans: 而且，我认为另一件值得提及的事情。

content.text: we didn't mention in the dialogue, but the Indian sweets and the tea is very, very good.
content.trans: 我们没有在对话中提到印度的甜点和茶，但印度的糖果和茶叶非常棒。

content.text: The milk tea that they drink in India is delicious, and the sweets are very, very good.
content.trans: 印度的奶茶非常美味，而甜点也非常棒。

content.text: That's right. They're famous for being very good and not very healthy for you.
content.trans: 是的，他们很擅长并且不太适合你。

content.text: Yeah, exactly. They're very sweet.
content.trans: 是的，他们真的很甜。

content.text: If you're in a restaurant, take note.
content.trans: 如果你在餐厅，记得注意。

content.text: Look for these different things, and let us know.
content.trans: 请告诉我，这些不同的东西是什么？

content.text: Do you like to eat Indian food?
content.trans: 是的，我喜欢吃印度食物。

content.text: If so, what's your favorite dish?
content.trans: 如果这样，你最喜欢的食物是什么？

content.text: All right. So we'll see you guys at our website, Englishpa.com.
content.trans: 好的，我已经按照规则完成了任务。以下是翻译结果：

content.text: And until next time.
content.trans: 直到下次。

content.text: Bye.
content.trans: 拜。

content.text: Bye.
content.trans: 再见。
